g.text: SwiftDrop AI Assistant - Logical Data Model (in memory, not persisted)
: crow's foot. ● = required. Solid line = held by key.
Dotted line = logical link only: the userId is the prefix of the conversation key.
: all data is lost on restart. Conversations expire after 30 min idle;
the knowledge base is rebuilt from the Markdown files at every startup.
: architecture rule (ai-assistant owns no data); parcels,
users and fees are read live from their owning services through the gateway.
